summary: Reconcile effectless prepared release after linear base advance
description: Add a guarded release-specific reconciliation command for a prepared release with zero publication effects, a linear advanced main, and scoped dirty release candidate changes. Preserve candidate bytes and immutable release intent, fail closed on conflicts/effects/owners, atomically update workspace registry and frozen release state via supported code, and invalidate prior candidate verification.
acceptance: No-effect prepared candidate with linear advanced base reconciles without editing release candidate content; registry and frozen state move together; all prior verification invalidated.
Any publication effect, non-linear base, conflicting/changed candidate bytes, unowned workspace, or missing lock leaves state and candidate unchanged.
